highlights.title: Agents on all your computers
highlights.line: When you open Kosmos through its Kosmos+ address, the Agents view also lists the agents on your other connected computers.

highlights.title: See what a task changed
highlights.line: A closed task now shows what its agents did while they held it: files created or edited, how many commands ran, and tokens used.

highlights.title: Name an agent file as you add it
highlights.line: When Kosmos finds an agent file with no name in it, you can type a name on its row and add it in one go.

highlights.title: Token Usage for every provider
highlights.line: Settings > Token Usage now counts your OpenAI, Gemini and Grok agents beside Claude, per day, model and agent.

highlights.title: A refused Restore says why
highlights.line: Among your removed agents, a Restore that Kosmos refuses now reads Not restored and shows the reason.
